✨ gsc | HTML
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating the detection, proof, and verification of code vulnerabilities within CI/CD pipelines to improve application security.
✨ Key Features: • SAST, SCA, secrets, and IaC scanning with 69 detectors • Automated Proof-of-Concept (PoC) generation for findings • Proof-of-Fix verification to ensure vulnerabilities are actually resolved • Self-learning engine that re-scores detectors and deactivates noisy patterns
📖 Summary: GSC is a self-learning AppSec platform that automates the process of detecting, proving, and fixing security vulnerabilities in code. It generates runnable proof-of-concepts for findings, verifies fixes through re-running exploits, and integrates into CI/CD pipelines for continuous security.
